title: 2021 Stanford Commencement address by Atul Gawande
speaker: Atul Gawande

sentences.en: - Stanford University - Please join me in welcoming Dr. Atul Gawande.
sentences.zh: - 斯坦福大学 - 请和我一起欢迎 Atul Gawande 博士。

sentences.en: (applause) - Congratulations graduates.
sentences.zh: （掌声）——恭喜毕业生。

sentences.en: (applause) Thank you all. Thank you, president Tessa Levine.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）谢谢大家。谢谢你，泰莎·莱文总统。

sentences.en: Thank you to the faculty and thank you to all of you students for inviting me.
sentences.zh: 感谢各位老师，也感谢所有同学的邀请。

sentences.en: I can think of no greater honor than being asked back to your Alma Mater to speak at graduation, especially this graduation.
sentences.zh: 我认为没有什么比被邀请回到母校在毕业典礼上发言更荣幸的了，尤其是这次毕业典礼。

sentences.en: In may, I celebrated the graduation of my own child from college from Berkeley College of Music, not that Berkeley, and it was such a beautiful milestone.
sentences.zh: 五月，我庆祝了自己的孩子从伯克利音乐学院（而不是伯克利音乐学院）毕业，这是一个如此美丽的里程碑。

sentences.en: But I have to admit it was deflating to have to mark it from our family room.
sentences.zh: 但我不得不承认，不得不在我们的家庭房间里标记它是令人泄气的。

sentences.en: Hunter sat on the couch, in cap and gown, watching the virtual ceremony waiting for their name to appear after a tough year of virtual music school without ensembles,
sentences.zh: 亨特坐在沙发上，戴着帽子和长袍，观看虚拟仪式，等待他们的名字出现，在虚拟音乐学校度过了艰难的一年，没有合奏团，

sentences.en: without performances. To think that a month later, just one month later, we could be here together with you is thrilling.
sentences.zh: 没有表演。一想到一个月后，仅仅一个月后，我们就能和你们在一起，真是令人兴奋。

sentences.en: The past pandemic year blew up all of our lives.
sentences.zh: 过去一年的大流行毁掉了我们所有人的生活。

sentences.en: So many suffered. The Corona virus has taken millions of people from this planet and it made tens of millions more so sick, they had to be in a hospital in order to keep breathing.
sentences.zh: 这么多人受苦。冠状病毒已经夺走了这个星球上数百万人的生命，并使数以千万计的人病重，他们必须住院才能继续呼吸。

sentences.en: Those with the least wealth and opportunity, those who couldn't retreat behind their screens suffered most.
sentences.zh: 那些财富和机会最少的人，以及那些无法退到屏幕后面的人，遭受的痛苦最大。

sentences.en: But no one escaped loss of some kind. The disease grounded our planes.
sentences.zh: 但没有人能逃脱某种损失。这种疾病导致我们的飞机停飞。

sentences.en: It closed our borders. It shuttered workplaces and schools.
sentences.zh: 它关闭了我们的边界。它关闭了工作场所和学校。

sentences.en: It took away our ability to come together to hear music, to break bread, to hold weddings and funerals, to simply let children play.
sentences.zh: 它剥夺了我们聚在一起听音乐、吃面包、举行婚礼和葬礼、让孩子们玩耍的能力。

sentences.en: It did this for an entire year. For much of the world, the worst is not passed.
sentences.zh: 它这样做了整整一年。对于世界上大部分地区来说，最糟糕的情况还没有过去。

sentences.en: In the first few months of 2021, more people died from the Corona virus pandemic, than in all of 2020.
sentences.zh: 2021 年前几个月，死于新冠病毒大流行的人数比 2020 年全年还要多。

sentences.en: We are so lucky to live in this country, which has supplied such remarkably effective vaccines and in such quantities that we're now giving away hundreds of millions of doses
sentences.zh: 我们很幸运生活在这个国家，它提供了非常有效的疫苗，而且数量如此之多，以至于我们现在正在分发数亿剂疫苗

sentences.en: globally. (applause) Vaccines reached so many people,
sentences.zh: 全球。 （掌声）疫苗惠及这么多人，

sentences.en: that against all expectations, we can gather here like this to cheer for you at graduation.
sentences.zh: 没想到，我们竟然能这样相聚在这里，为毕业的你们喝彩。

sentences.en: (applause) Woo! I remember my graduation one sunlit day like this years ago.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）哇！我记得像几年前的一个阳光明媚的日子我毕业了。

sentences.en: I remember the joy of precessing into the stadium with my friends.
sentences.zh: 我记得和朋友们一起走进体育场的喜悦。

sentences.en: I remember scanning the crowd to look for the smiling faces of my family members.
sentences.zh: 我记得扫视人群寻找我家人的笑脸。

sentences.en: And I remember the annoying question everyone asks new graduates.
sentences.zh: 我还记得每个应届毕业生都会问的恼人的问题。

sentences.en: So what now for you? And I had an answer, more school.
sentences.zh: 那么你现在怎么办？我有一个答案，那就是更多的学校。

sentences.en: And your answer might be the same or it might be a job, a trip, a move back home.
sentences.zh: 你的答案可能是一样的，也可能是一份工作、一次旅行、搬回家。

sentences.en: But the truth was that none of us knew what was ahead for us.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，我们谁都不知道前面会发生什么。

sentences.en: Really, how could we? Many of my classmates would have careers doing work that did not even exist in 1987, when we stood where you are sitting.
sentences.zh: 真的，我们怎么能？我的许多同学从事的工作在 1987 年甚至不存在，当时我们就站在你们现在坐的地方。

sentences.en: For example, I had classmates who'd make their mark helping the people of a post-communist Russia and Eastern Europe, and a post apartheid South Africa, none of which was more than a fever dream back then.
sentences.zh: 例如，我有一些同学在帮助后共产主义的俄罗斯和东欧以及后种族隔离的南非人民中留下了自己的印记，而这些在当时都只是一个狂热的梦想。

sentences.en: My tech friends would later take jobs with names that would have been in comprehensible, such as app designer, driverless car engineer,
sentences.zh: 我的技术朋友后来会接受一些名字容易理解的工作，比如应用程序设计师、无人驾驶汽车工程师、

sentences.en: data scientist, chief information security officer, blogger, or for that manner, Peloton instructor.
sentences.zh: 数据科学家、首席信息安全官、博主，或者类似地，Peloton 讲师。

sentences.en: In medicine, friends later worked in unimagined fields like genomics, face transplantation and mRNA vaccine production.
sentences.zh: 在医学领域，朋友们后来在基因组学、面部移植和 mRNA 疫苗生产等难以想象的领域工作。

sentences.en: (applause) No less fantastical in public health, I have friends who would work to implement the country's first health reform program
sentences.zh: （掌声）在公共卫生领域同样充满幻想，我有朋友愿意努力实施该国第一个医疗改革计划

sentences.en: to seek universal coverage, signed into law by America's first black president.
sentences.zh: 寻求全民覆盖，由美国第一位黑人总统签署成为法律。

sentences.en: (applause) My classmates would also have personal life experiences that were equally unpredictable, though more familiar.
sentences.zh: （掌声）我的同学们也会有同样不可预测的个人生活经历，尽管更加熟悉。

sentences.en: They'd fall in love. They'd fall out of love.
sentences.zh: 他们会坠入爱河的。他们会失恋的。

sentences.en: They'd navigate sickness and injury. They'd grow families and they'd lose family members.
sentences.zh: 他们会克服疾病和受伤。他们会组建家庭，也会失去家庭成员。

sentences.en: A few died way too soon. What now, is a question you will ask your whole life.
sentences.zh: 有几个死得太早了。现在做什么，是你一生都会问的问题。

sentences.en: Entering medical school, I had a plan. I liked plans.
sentences.zh: 进入医学院后，我有一个计划。我喜欢计划。

sentences.en: (laughs) I wanted to do public health research and practice medicine.
sentences.zh: （笑）我想做公共卫生研究和行医。

sentences.en: So I planned to train in primary care. The specialty fit these interests, and as a bonus that had the shortest residency program.
sentences.zh: 所以我计划接受初级保健方面的培训。该专业符合这些兴趣，并且作为奖励，它拥有最短的住院医师计划。

sentences.en: But then my clinical rotation in surgery upended my tidy scheme.
sentences.zh: 但后来我的临床轮转颠覆了我的整洁计划。

sentences.en: What I saw captivated me. The sur realness of opening the bodies of living people drew me in, instead of pushing me away.
sentences.zh: 我所看到的让我着迷。打开活人尸体的超现实感吸引了我，而不是把我推开。

sentences.en: And so did the surgeons, all of them ordinary, flawed human beings, with imperfect skills, incomplete knowledge and yet the confidence to nonetheless act
sentences.zh: 外科医生也是如此，他们都是普通的、有缺陷的人，技术不完善，知识不完整，但仍然有信心采取行动

sentences.en: and to take accountability for whatever outcome resulted.
sentences.zh: 并对由此产生的任何结果承担责任。

sentences.en: People say in moments like this, follow your passion.
sentences.zh: 人们说，在这样的时刻，追随你的激情。

sentences.en: But how many of you even know what that is?
sentences.zh: 但你们中有多少人知道那是什么？

sentences.en: I didn't. I had my share of enthusiasms, but sitting where you are, I wouldn't have called any of them my passion.
sentences.zh: 我没有。我也有自己的热情，但坐在你的位置上，我不会把其中任何一个称为我的热情。

sentences.en: I had no idea which enthusiasms would endure and which would fade.
sentences.zh: 我不知道哪些热情会持续下去，哪些会消退。

sentences.en: Over time, however, I came to be able to tell the difference between the things in merely absorbed me.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着时间的推移，我逐渐能够区分出那些仅仅让我着迷的事物之间的区别。

sentences.en: the way that TikTok videos do now, and things that energized me.
sentences.zh: TikTok 视频现在的方式，以及那些给我带来活力的事情。

sentences.en: Seeing the difference took a while. Coming to Stanford from rural Ohio was mind blowing.
sentences.zh: 看到差异需要一段时间。从俄亥俄州农村来到斯坦福大学真是令人兴奋。

sentences.en: It exposed me to a wider range of things to do and to be than I'd known.
sentences.zh: 它让我接触到比我所知道的更广泛的事情。

sentences.en: During freshman year, my roommates and I signed up at KZSU for a late night slot, spinning records.
sentences.zh: 大一的时候，我和我的室友在 KZSU 报名参加了一个深夜时段，旋转唱片。

sentences.en: A professor gave me a job in his laboratory working on a devastating retinol disease.
sentences.zh: 一位教授给了我一份工作，让我在他的实验室里研究一种毁灭性的视黄醇疾病。

sentences.en: I learned to play electric guitar. I volunteered to stuff envelopes for a presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 我学会了弹电吉他。我自愿为总统竞选活动装信封。

sentences.en: Many of these interests came and went but I came to recognize when something truly energized me.
sentences.zh: 其中许多兴趣来来去去，但我开始意识到什么时候有什么真正能让我充满活力。

sentences.en: The radio show, for example, was not such a case.
sentences.zh: 例如，广播节目就不是这样的情况。

sentences.en: Our slot was Tuesdays, from 2:00 AM to 5:00 AM.
sentences.zh: 我们的时段是每周二，从凌晨 2:00 到凌晨 5:00。

sentences.en: After two or three shows, the fun of our on-air repartee and championing our latest new wave heroes waned dramatically.
sentences.zh: 两三场演出之后，我们的直播妙语连珠和支持我们最新的新浪潮英雄的乐趣急剧减弱。

sentences.en: I began sleeping in and I totally flaked out on my roommates.
sentences.zh: 我开始睡懒觉，对室友们彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: On the other hand, I consistently lost time in the lab.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我总是在实验室里浪费时间。

sentences.en: Likewise, for my late night discussions with my political science friends.
sentences.zh: 同样，对于我与政治学朋友的深夜讨论。

sentences.en: I ended up taking so many policy and political theory electives that I added a second major to my biology major.
sentences.zh: 我最终选修了很多政策和政治理论选修课，以至于我在生物学专业的基础上又增加了第二个专业。

sentences.en: I wasn't good at anything yet, but I found a few things I was willing to work at long enough to get better.
sentences.zh: 我还不擅长任何事情，但我发现了一些我愿意花足够长时间工作以变得更好的事情。

sentences.en: And I learned to pay attention when that happened.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，我学会了集中注意力。

sentences.en: More recently, I attended a talk by Dr. Bob Wachter, who now chairs the department of medicine at UCSF.
sentences.zh: 最近，我参加了 Bob Wachter 博士的演讲，他现任加州大学旧金山分校医学系主任。

sentences.en: Answering a question from a graduate student seeking advice, he said something that stuck with me.
sentences.zh: 在回答一位寻求建议的研究生的问题时，他说了一些让我印象深刻的话。

sentences.en: He said, "say yes to everything before you're 40 and say no to everything after you're 40."
sentences.zh: 他说，“40岁之前对一切说‘是’，40岁之后对一切说‘不’。”

sentences.en: And looking back, this was pretty much what I'd done, I'd realized.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，我意识到这几乎就是我所做的事情。

sentences.en: In your formative years, you don't know, you can't know what will ultimately matter to you.
sentences.zh: 在你的成长岁月里，你不知道、也不可能知道什么最终对你来说最重要。

sentences.en: What will grab you by the shoulders and awaken you and stay with you.
sentences.zh: 什么会抓住你的肩膀，唤醒你并留在你身边。

sentences.en: So you have to be open to trying stuff, to saying yes.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须乐于尝试，敢于说“是”。

sentences.en: As you do, pay attention to what fuels you, and what doesn't.
sentences.zh: 当你这样做的时候，注意什么能给你动力，什么不能。

sentences.en: You want to pull apart the experience and figure out specifically what lifted you and what sapped you.
sentences.zh: 你想要分解这段经历，明确是什么让你振奋，什么让你沮丧。

sentences.en: And then you want to do all you can to organize your life to do more of the first and less of the second.
sentences.zh: 然后你会想尽你所能来安排你的生活，多做第一件事，少做第二件事。

sentences.en: With me, for example, I found I was endlessly interested in getting under the surface to understand how the systems we depend on fail, the flaws of the complex systems inside our bodies,
sentences.zh: 以我为例，我发现我对深入了解我们所依赖的系统如何失败、我们体内复杂系统的缺陷、

sentences.en: and also inside our society that caused suffering.
sentences.zh: 也在我们的社会内部造成了痛苦。

sentences.en: I had experiences that revealed to me the love of getting my hands in there to tinker with the systems and figure out what was possible to fix.
sentences.zh: 我的经历告诉我，我喜欢亲自动手修补系统并找出可以修复的地方。

sentences.en: Knowledge was one thing, but execution was another.
sentences.zh: 知识是一回事，但执行又是另一回事。

sentences.en: And I found, I cared about both. In further experiences, I learned that I love dissembling the story of what happens when people try to fix systems failures, how they succeed and how they don't.
sentences.zh: 我发现，我两者都关心。在进一步的经验中，我了解到我喜欢揭露当人们尝试修复系统故障时会发生什么、他们如何成功和如何失败的故事。

sentences.en: For a long time, that meant I was pulled in three directions; to surgery, public health and journalism.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间，这意味着我被拉向三个方向：外科、公共卫生和新闻业。

sentences.en: Over and over people told me to choose. "These things didn't fit together."
sentences.zh: 人们一遍又一遍地告诉我要选择。 “这些东西不适合在一起。”

sentences.en: they'd say. And for a very, very long time, they were right.
sentences.zh: 他们会说。在很长一段时间里，他们是对的。

sentences.en: They didn't fit together. All I saw was that each separately added something that fed me.
sentences.zh: 他们不适合在一起。我所看到的只是每个人都分别添加了一些可以满足我需求的东西。

sentences.en: And eventually each fed the other. Surgery showed me the day-to-day reality of illness and our inadequate health systems.
sentences.zh: 最终彼此喂饱。手术向我展示了疾病的日常现实以及我们不完善的卫生系统。

sentences.en: Writing let me investigate the flaws and ways to address them, and public health training showed me how to design systemic solutions and deliver them at population scale.
sentences.zh: 写作让我调查了缺陷和解决它们的方法，公共卫生培训向我展示了如何设计系统性解决方案并在人口规模上提供它们。

sentences.en: For example, to deliver a team checklist for safer surgery that's now been adopted worldwide and saved more people from death and disability than car accidents inflict, or to design a structured conversation between
sentences.zh: 例如，提供一份更安全手术的团队清单，该清单现已在全球范围内采用，比车祸所造成的死亡和残疾人数要多得多，或者设计一个结构化的对话

sentences.en: clinicians and patients with serious illness, to ensure that treatment plans incorporate people's priorities for their lives, besides just surviving.
sentences.zh: 临床医生和患有严重疾病的患者，以确保治疗计划除了生存之外还考虑到人们生活的优先事项。

sentences.en: Or to build mass vaccination centers and COVID testing programs to help us escape from this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 或者建立大规模疫苗接种中心和新冠病毒检测项目来帮助我们摆脱这一流行病。

sentences.en: Every few years, I've faced a pivotal choice that scared me.
sentences.zh: 每隔几年，我都会面临一个令我害怕的关键选择。

sentences.en: One was deciding to train in surgery instead of an internal medicine.
sentences.zh: 其中一个决定接受外科培训而不是内科培训。

sentences.en: The training was eight years, instead of three years.
sentences.zh: 培训时间是八年，而不是三年。

sentences.en: My wife, Kathleen, we met here at Okada house, was pregnant with our first child.
sentences.zh: 我们在冈田家认识的我的妻子凯瑟琳正怀着我们的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: Surgery was not a natural cultural fit for me.
sentences.zh: 手术不适合我的文化。

sentences.en: My mentors in public health thought the direction was baffling, but still there have been that poll during three months on service.
sentences.zh: 我的公共卫生导师认为这个方向令人困惑，但在服役的三个月内仍然进行了这项民意调查。

sentences.en: So I told myself that I could transfer out if it didn't work.
sentences.zh: 于是我告诉自己，实在不行我就可以转出去。

sentences.en: And I said yes to surgery. Three years later, I also said yes to writing.
sentences.zh: 我同意手术。三年后，我也对写作说“是”。

sentences.en: Yes, a blog on the side. (laughs) And then during a two year research period with only light clinical duties, I said yes to a chance to write longer pieces for the New Yorker Magazine.
sentences.zh: 是的，旁边有一个博客。 （笑）然后，在两年的研究期间，我只承担了少量的临床职责，我答应了为《纽约客》杂志撰写较长文章的机会。

sentences.en: A few months after I returned to full hospital duties, a publisher offered me the chance to expand those pieces into a book.
sentences.zh: 在我回到医院履行全部职责几个月后，一家出版商向我提供了将这些作品扩展成书的机会。

sentences.en: And I remember the day at the hospital that I said yes into the phone and accepted the contract.
sentences.zh: 我记得在医院的那天，我在电话里答应了并接受了合同。

sentences.en: It was later when I got home that night- It was late when I got home that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我回到家的时候已经很晚了——那天晚上我回到家已经很晚了。

sentences.en: I have three children by then and they were asleep upstairs.
sentences.zh: 那时我已经有了三个孩子，他们在楼上睡着了。

sentences.en: And suddenly, I was flat on my back in a panic on the living room floor.
sentences.zh: 突然，我惊慌地平躺在客厅的地板上。

sentences.en: What did I just commit to doing? How in the world was I going to deliver during residency?
sentences.zh: 我刚才承诺做什么？在住院期间我到底要如何分娩？

sentences.en: Kathleen, my wife, had thought it was crazy too but she reminded me that I had already demonstrated the energy to stay up an extra hour or two each night or to steal time between operations
sentences.zh: 我的妻子凯瑟琳（Kathleen）也认为这很疯狂，但她提醒我，我已经表现出了每晚多熬一两个小时或在两次手术之间挤出时间的精力。

sentences.en: to write. So I stilled my pounding heart.
sentences.zh: 写。于是我平复了我那颗狂跳的心。

sentences.en: I kept making time for what energized and motivated me and kept trying to remove time from what beat me down.
sentences.zh: 我不断地腾出时间来做那些让我充满活力和动力的事情，并不断地努力从那些让我沮丧的事情上抽出时间。

sentences.en: And this meant doing things that didn't fit with my plan or the images that others had of me, but I never regretted it.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要做一些不符合我的计划或别人对我的印象的事情，但我从不后悔。

sentences.en: I've had great luck and privilege just to have the opportunities I've had, like even trying to do surgery or to write.
sentences.zh: 我非常幸运和荣幸，能够拥有我所拥有的机会，比如尝试做手术或写作。

sentences.en: Simply by being in this community, you too have had choices and exposures that few others have.
sentences.zh: 只要身处这个社区，您也能拥有其他人很少有的选择和接触机会。

sentences.en: Most people face far tighter constraints on their life.
sentences.zh: 大多数人的生活都面临着更严格的限制。

sentences.en: But I've seen that even patients facing the end of life, the tightest constraint of all, have had room to assert their priorities in their lives, besides just living longer
sentences.zh: 但我发现，即使是面临生命终结（最严格的限制）的患者，除了活得更长之外，也有空间来坚持自己生命中的优先事项

sentences.en: to maximize time for what lifts them up and to try to limit what brings them down.
sentences.zh: 最大限度地利用时间去做让他们振奋的事情，并尽量限制让他们沮丧的事情。

sentences.en: The other half of Bob Wachter's advice, however was, "say no to everything after you're 40".
sentences.zh: 然而，鲍勃·沃切特 (Bob Wachter) 的另一半建议是，“40 岁之后就对一切说不”。

sentences.en: By that, he meant, that by that age, you should know enough about yourself, but what really matters, to you to focus on that.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是，到了那个年纪，你应该对自己有足够的了解，但真正重要的是你要专注于这一点。

sentences.en: In fact, you have to say no to focus on that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你必须拒绝才能专注于此。

sentences.en: As you get older, this will become your advantage.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄的增长，这将成为你的优势。

sentences.en: You begin to know yourself, your capabilities, your gaps, what motivates you well enough to commit to efforts that can run a long time to realize, years,
sentences.zh: 你开始了解你自己，你的能力，你的差距，是什么激励你足够努力地致力于可以持续很长时间才能实现的努力，几年，

sentences.en: decades, if necessary. You even become willing to work for goals that will not be achieved in your lifetime.
sentences.zh: 几十年，如果有必要的话。你甚至愿意为一生中无法实现的目标而努力。

sentences.en: I want to return to COVID for a moment. This plague forced us all to see our lives anew.
sentences.zh: 我想暂时回到新冠肺炎这个话题。这场瘟疫迫使我们所有人重新审视自己的生活。

sentences.en: Under crisis, we had to pair our lives down.
sentences.zh: 在危机之下，我们不得不将生活配对。

sentences.en: We had to jettison what could be jettisoned.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不抛弃那些可以抛弃的东西。

sentences.en: And we had to keep what truly mattered. We had to try living in new ways.
sentences.zh: 我们必须保留真正重要的东西。我们必须尝试以新的方式生活。

sentences.en: We had to figure out how to endure. For me, dealing with the uncertainty was the hardest part.
sentences.zh: 我们必须弄清楚如何忍受。对我来说，应对不确定性是最困难的部分。

sentences.en: How long would this plague last? How bad would it get?
sentences.zh: 这场瘟疫会持续多久？情况会变得多么糟糕？

sentences.en: What troubled me most though was, the fact that so much of the uncertainty was human made, instead of virus made.
sentences.zh: 但最让我困扰的是，很多不确定性都是人为造成的，而不是病毒造成的。

sentences.en: The pandemic was and it still is a spreading fire.
sentences.zh: 这场流行病过去是、现在仍然是一场蔓延的大火。

sentences.en: Experts actually figured out, rather quickly, how to stop it.
sentences.zh: 专家们实际上很快就想出了如何阻止它。

sentences.en: With wide testing, masks, avoiding indoor crowds, use of good ventilation and ultimately with vaccination.
sentences.zh: 通过广泛的检测、佩戴口罩、避免室内人群、保持良好的通风以及最终接种疫苗。

sentences.en: But knowledge is one thing, and execution is another.
sentences.zh: 但知识是一回事，执行又是另一回事。

sentences.en: Those communities that came together across political lines, take knowledge of the threat and fight the fire, were able to stop the fire.
sentences.zh: 那些跨越政治界限走到一起、了解威胁并扑灭大火的社区最终成功扑灭了大火。

sentences.en: Our nation did not come together. The fact that we could not collectively summon the commitment required, that we've had key leaders who saw political opportunity and undermining that commitment, has been distressing beyond words.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家没有走到一起。事实上，我们无法集体做出所需的承诺，我们的关键领导人看到了政治机会并破坏了这一承诺，这一事实令人难以言喻。

sentences.en: Leaders have a choice. They can move ahead by driving division and stoking fear or they can move ahead by binding us together and confronting our fears.
sentences.zh: 领导者有选择。他们可以通过推动分裂和煽动恐惧来前进，也可以通过将我们团结在一起并直面恐惧来前进。

sentences.en: The divisive path generates attention more easily and generates more immediate gratification.
sentences.zh: 分裂路径更容易引起注意并产生更直接的满足感。

sentences.en: That means we'll always have those who will take the divisive path.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们总会有人走上分裂的道路。

sentences.en: The fact that path is ultimately dispiriting for people, however, while the other path raises our spirits up, gave me confidence about which eventually would prevail.
sentences.zh: 然而，这条道路最终会让人们感到沮丧，而另一条道路却能让我们振奋起来，这一事实让我相信哪条道路最终会获胜。

sentences.en: That confidence has been shaken to be sure but we stand here together today because enough of us have come together across political lines and increasingly across countries, to take up the vaccines
sentences.zh: 可以肯定的是，这种信心已经动摇，但我们今天站在一起，是因为我们中有足够多的人跨越政治界限、越来越多地跨越国家走到一起，拿起疫苗

sentences.en: and fight the fire. The difference between- (applause) The difference between these two paths is worth remembering
sentences.zh: 并救火。区别-（鼓掌）这两条路的区别值得记住

sentences.en: as we each encounter that what now question in our lives.
sentences.zh: 当我们每个人在生活中遇到现在的问题时。

sentences.en: That question about what we individually will commit to next.
sentences.zh: 关于我们下一步将致力于什么的问题。

sentences.en: All of us are seeking how to express our worth and everyone does have worth, equally with everyone else's human beings, we do just by being here in this world.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都在寻求如何表达我们的价值，每个人都拥有价值，与其他人一样，我们只是存在于这个世界上。

sentences.en: To discover how to express that worth, you just have to keep saying yes until you found it.
sentences.zh: 要发现如何表达这种价值，您只需不断地说“是”，直到找到它为止。

sentences.en: And if you do that, you will find it. But the better choices are not often the easiest or most enjoyable ones.
sentences.zh: 如果你这样做，你就会找到它。但更好的选择往往不是最简单或最令人愉快的选择。

sentences.en: The most meaningful goals are usually slow to achieve.
sentences.zh: 最有意义的目标通常实现起来很缓慢。

sentences.en: They're also usually the ones that bind people together rather than push them apart.
sentences.zh: 它们通常也是将人们联系在一起而不是分开的人。

sentences.en: That feeds not only your purposes, but feeds their purposes.
sentences.zh: 这不仅满足了你的目的，也满足了他们的目的。

sentences.en: For it turns out that the beautiful secret of how our species is made, is that we are often most energized when we help others express their worth.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，我们这个物种的美丽秘密在于，当我们帮助他人表达他们的价值时，我们往往会感到最有活力。

sentences.en: That truth is easy to miss behind our screens.
sentences.zh: 我们很容易在屏幕后面忽略这一事实。

sentences.en: watching the news, when separated from one another.
sentences.zh: 当彼此分开时，看新闻。

sentences.en: But it is the reason why we all, all of us here have gathered and why we hold such confidence in you.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我们所有人聚集在一起的原因，也是我们对你们充满信心的原因。

sentences.en: And this truth is why we believe you and your entire generation are the reason our better angels will prevail.
sentences.zh: 这个事实就是为什么我们相信你们和你们这一代人是我们更好的天使将获胜的原因。

sentences.en: Thank you. (applause) - For more, please visit us www.stanford.edu.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。 （掌声） - 欲了解更多信息，请访问我们的 www.stanford.edu。
